name: Boiled egg & yogurt bowl
steps: Cover two eggs with water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer for about 10–12 minutes until the white and yolk are firm.
Cool in clean cold water, peel and chop.
Mix 150 g plain yogurt with 100 g chopped cucumber, tomato and onion. Add a pinch of cumin and pepper.
Top with eggs and serve. Optional roti is logged separately.
note: Optional protein meal, not compulsory. Use pasteurized yogurt. Eat promptly; without a fridge, make only what you will eat now.
imageAlt: Illustration of Boiled egg & yogurt bowl

name: Budget chana chaat
equipment: Knife, bowl; no stove if chickpeas are pre-cooked
steps: Use 150 g cooked drained chickpeas, or rinse canned chickpeas. Never use raw dried chickpeas.
Chop cucumber, tomato and onion to make 150 g salad.
Mix with chickpeas, lemon juice, cumin and a small pinch of salt.
Serve immediately. Add a roti separately if you want a larger meal.
note: Lemon and small spice amounts are not included in the estimate. A cheaper alternative to buying specialty nuts.

name: Simple milk oats
steps: Put 40 g dry oats and 200 ml pasteurized milk in a saucepan.
Simmer for 4–6 minutes, stirring until soft. Add water if too thick.
Slice half a medium banana on top. Cinnamon is optional.
Serve warm without added sugar. This can be an evening meal; breakfast is optional.
note: If using raw milk, boil it before use. Milk and banana can be replaced; log replacements separately.

name: One-pot lentil bowl
steps: Rinse dry red lentils and simmer in water until completely soft, roughly 15–25 minutes. Add water as needed.
Measure 250 g of the cooked lentils for this serving. Dry and cooked weights are different.
Stir in 1 teaspoon oil and cumin or turmeric; warm through.
Serve with 100 g chopped salad and one medium plain roti.
note: Cook enough lentils to yield the stated cooked weight. Refrigerate leftovers promptly; do not leave a pot out overnight.

name: Chicken & yogurt roti wrap
equipment: Knife and bowl; cooked chicken required
steps: Use 100 g safely cooked, boneless skinless chicken; shred it.
Mix with 50 g yogurt, black pepper and a little lemon.
Fill one plain roti with the chicken mixture and 100 g salad.
Fold and eat promptly. Avoid mayonnaise unless you log it separately.
note: Use freshly cooked chicken or safely refrigerated leftovers. This recipe does not instruct cooking raw chicken.
imageAlt: Illustration of Chicken & yogurt roti wrap

name: No-cook fruit & peanut snack
steps: Wash and chop one medium apple.
Measure 20 g shelled plain peanuts.
Serve together; no cream or syrup needed.
note: A snack, not a high-protein replacement for dinner. Avoid peanuts if allergic.
imageAlt: Illustration of No-cook fruit & peanut snack
